overview_description.description: The Saudi Real Estate Refinance Company (SRC) develops the housing finance market in Saudi Arabia. Owned by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), SRC operates in the secondary real estate market under the supervision of the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA). The company provides long-term financing solutions to support deposit-taking institutions and align mortgage portfolios with regulatory standards. As part of its role in the Vision 2030 initiative, SRC aims to increase homeownership rates and facilitate growth in the primary mortgage market.

about_short_description.short_description: Saudi Real Estate Refinance provides long-term financing solutions to support and develop the housing finance market.

product.name: Refinancing Loan Portfolios
product.description: SRC enables originators to offer home financing solutions by refinancing their loan portfolios, providing continuous liquidity to lenders.

product.name: Issuing Sukuk
product.description: SRC raises capital by issuing sukuk, which helps provide liquidity to mortgage providers.

product.name: Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS)
product.description: SRC aggregates loan portfolios and packages them into Mortgage-Backed Securities to sell to investors.

product.name: Short Term & Long Term Funding
product.description: SRC provides short and long-term funding to partners for housing financing, collateralized by housing financing contracts.

product.name: Long Term Structured Deposit
product.description: SRC offers a long-term financing solution for deposit-taking partners, matched with an equivalent portfolio of conforming financings.

product.name: Portfolio Acquisition with Recourse
product.description: SRC acquires housing financing loans from partners on a recourse basis, where non-performing loans are repurchased or replaced by the seller.
